PanelDescription.SourceString: 菲林轨迹照相馆门口，达芙蒂尔又来打印照片了……

PanelDescription.SourceString: 上晴塔Firmament是海特洛的名流们不约而同选择的餐厅，据说顶层的夜景别有一番风味，或许在这里，会碰到意想不到的人……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Firmament at Hethereau Skytower is the go-to restaurant for Hethereau's elite. They say the night view from the top floor has a charm all its own. Perhaps I might run into someone unexpected here…
